description: This file declares reduction operations for Tensor expressions in PyTorch, such as sum, mean, adaptive average pooling, and max.

methods.name: computeSum
methods.description: Computes the sum reduction over input tensors with specified output shape, strides, and type, on the given device.

methods.name: computeMean
methods.description: Computes the mean reduction over input tensors with specified output shape, strides, and type, on the given device.

methods.name: computeAdaptiveAvgPool2d
methods.description: Computes 2D adaptive average pooling over input tensors with specified output shape, strides, and type, on the given device.

methods.name: computeMax
methods.description: Computes the maximum value reduction over input tensors with specified output shape, strides, and type, on the given device.
